name: Instinción (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a purple diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Instinción (grapes on purple above waves and a flower on white).
history: The arms were approved on 2 July 2002 together with the flag of the locality.

features.role: diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
